note: Break room chatter: one person says one line on the week summary. Moods: good, tired (morale under 45), crunch (a crunch week).

hal.good: Good week. Don't tell anyone I said that.
hal.tired: Team's running on fumes. Make them rest. That's an order. Mostly.
hal.crunch: Crunch week. I've seen this movie before. Bring snacks.

dev.good: Cool cool cool! I tightened a bolt and nobody had to redo it!
dev.tired: Cool... cool... is it normal to see bolts when I close my eyes?
dev.crunch: Crunch week! I made a playlist! It's ninety hours long!

inez.good: Checklist complete. I made a new checklist to celebrate.
inez.tired: Item one on my list: sleep. I have not checked it off.
inez.crunch: Crunch week. Trust, but verify. Then verify the verifying.

skye.good: Team spirits are sunny, with a high of awesome!
skye.tired: Forecast for this team: cloudy, with a big chance of naps.
skye.crunch: Crunch week! Expect a storm of work and scattered coffee.

marty.good: Every shipment on time! I don't trust it. Don't panic.
marty.tired: My phone rang 400 times. I answered 399. Okay, panic a little.
marty.crunch: Crunch week? I've got three phones and one ear. Let's go!

tasha.good: 'Tiny Team Has Huge Week!' That's a headline!
tasha.tired: 'Exhausted Heroes Need Nap.' Not my best headline. Like us.
tasha.crunch: 'Crunch Week: Rocket Team Refuses to Blink!' That's a headline!

amara.good: Flying this thing will be easy. Building it, less easy. Still easy.
amara.tired: Even I need a nap. Don't tell the other pilots.
amara.crunch: Crunch week? Easy. Where's the coffee? Easy.

jun.good: The capsule and I had a good talk today. Technically, I talked.
jun.tired: Technically, I am awake. My eyes disagree.
jun.crunch: Crunch week. I told the rocket. It took it well.

lucia.good: A good week. Breathe. Then enjoy it.
lucia.tired: Everyone is tired. Breathe. Then rest. Then decide.
lucia.crunch: Crunch week. Breathe. Then decide. Then do it fast.

dmitri.good: In my day, a good week meant nothing went bang. Good week.
dmitri.tired: In my day, we slept on the launch pad. I do not recommend it.
dmitri.crunch: In my day, every week was crunch week. You will survive.

priya.good: Sorry, quick question. Is it okay to feel this proud?
priya.tired: Sorry, quick question. Do rockets need naps? Asking for me.
priya.crunch: Sorry, quick question. Is crunch week always this crunchy?

sam.good: Roger that, boss. Great week. I only dropped one wrench.
sam.tired: Roger that, boss. Running on two hours of sleep and one joke.
sam.crunch: Crunch week? Roger that, boss. I'll bring the cereal. Crunchy.

zainab.good: A nearly perfect week. One more check and it will be perfect.
zainab.tired: I did one more check. Then forty more. I should sleep.
zainab.crunch: Crunch week. No time for one more check. I will do it anyway.

mateo.good: Great week! We did everything. Wait, did we do that?
mateo.tired: So tired I forgot my lunch. Wait, did I eat it? I ate it.
mateo.crunch: Crunch week! I made a list so I don't forget. Where's the list?
